ablation.convention: delta = metric(ablation) - metric(B4) for every metric below

interpretation.group: predictive reliance on the family as a whole; preferred for the headline diagnostic reading
interpretation.individual: UNIQUE information conditional on the remaining correlated features
interpretation.nearZeroIndividual: does NOT imply the feature carries no information when correlated substitutes exist

ale.aggregation: descriptive median across folds by decile index; no significance
ale.binEdges: equal-count quantiles of the fold's TRAINING values of the feature; duplicates collapse
ale.centering: count-weighted mean of the accumulated effect over the bins with a defined accumulated value
ale.evaluatedOn: out-of-fold validation rows of the fold, assigned to the training-derived bins; only rows with an observed value
ale.method: 1-dimensional Accumulated Local Effects of B5 (not PDP, not SHAP)
ale.scale: B5 predicted expected relative return, centered
ale.shap: not a dependency and not the authoritative importance method
ale.unsupportedBins: reported UNSUPPORTED with a null effect; never extrapolated, interpolated or bridged

coefficientStability.interpretation: MODEL COEFFICIENTS under training-only robust scaling; never causal effects; no significance label
coefficientStability.l2DriftRule: Euclidean norm of the difference of consecutive coefficient vectors over every value and missing-indicator entry of the horizon's registry; an omitted feature contributes 0
coefficientStability.model: B4 Ridge, every annual expanding-window fit, per horizon and per active feature
coefficientStability.signFlipRule: count of sign changes between consecutive evaluation refits, exact zeros carrying the previous sign

ACCOUNTING.at21: NOT_APPLICABLE: no accounting field is registered at H21

featureGroups.note: Semantic groups for ATTRIBUTION ONLY. They do not alter the frozen feature registry, B2, B3 or B4.

firewall.diagnosticFailureRule: reported separately as DIAGNOSTIC_ERROR; never changes a primary status or payload and never authorises a substantive retry
firewall.futurePromotionOfAnyFindingRequires: a NEW preregistered study or version; nothing here is evidence for a claim
primaryFirst: construct the complete registered primary result
only then run diagnostics on immutable copies
embed the unchanged primary payload and its original hash; add references only

headConcordance.deciles: within each signal date, ties broken by ticker ascending, pooled by decile index
headConcordance.disagreement: expected relative return > 0 with probability < 0.5, and expected relative return <= 0 with probability >= 0.5

ledger.rows: every out-of-fold evaluated name-date of the primary evaluation tables
ledger.serialization: canonical JSON lines, sorted keys, gzip with mtime 0

linearVsNonlinear.comparison: B4 Ridge (primary) against B5 HGB (descriptive), out-of-fold
linearVsNonlinear.quintileRule: top and bottom ceil(n/5) names of each date by prediction, ties broken by ticker ascending

parent.relationship: SUPPLEMENT_NOT_AMENDMENT: this is not a v5.1 primary preregistration and changes nothing the parent froze

predictionDecomposition.identity: intercept + sum_j (valueCoefficient_j * transformedFeature_j + missingIndicatorCoefficient_j * missingIndicator_j) == B4 prediction
predictionDecomposition.logistic: the same exact decomposition on the LOG-ODDS scale only; never probability-scale additivity

prohibitions: no diagnostic output may enter a primary status, interval, threshold, selection, model choice or retry decision
no significance label, p-value, promoted predictor or winner is produced
no outcome-optimized threshold, bin, group or regime
no new feature, interaction, model or hyperparameter

redundancy.combinedWith: individual and group ablation, reported side by side with no verdict label
redundancy.features: active features after the frozen signed-log transform, pairwise-complete, before imputation
redundancy.weights: each row weighted 1/(rows on its signal date); Spearman uses average ranks within the pairwise-complete set

references.note: Methodological motivation only. None of these validates any Alpha-v5 result.
works: Gu, Kelly & Xiu (2020), Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning, Review of Financial Studies
Harvey, Liu & Zhu (2016), ...and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns, Review of Financial Studies
Harvey, Sancetta & Zhao (2026), multiple testing and selection bias in the factor zoo
Fisher, Rudin & Dominici (2019), All Models are Wrong, but Many are Useful: model reliance, JMLR
Verdinelli & Wasserman (2024), Decorrelated Variable Importance, JMLR
Apley & Zhu (2020), Visualizing the effects of predictor variables in black box supervised learning models, JRSS-B

VOLATILITY.threshold: median of the same statistic over the STRICTLY EARLIER weekly signal dates, expanding
VOLATILITY.undetermined: UNDETERMINED when fewer than the minimum prior dates exist; excluded, never filled
VOLATILITY.variable: KR benchmark trailing 63-session realized volatility (sample std of 63 daily simple returns, annualised by sqrt(252))

regimes.informationRule: only information known at the signal date; no named historical event; no full-sample threshold
